question: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship scheme of the ______.

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana:-**

 
 
• The Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is a government of India scheme launched on July 15, 2015.
 
• **It provides skill training to unemployed youth and working professionals. The scheme aims to train 40 million people by 2022.**
 
• **It is a flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship.**
 
• The PMKVY is a demand-driven scheme, meaning that the courses offered are aligned with the needs of the industry.
 
• The scheme offers a wide range of courses, from short-term courses of 3 to 6 months to longer courses of 1 year or more.
 
• The PMKVY is open to all unemployed youth and working professionals who are at least 18 years old. There are no educational qualifications required to apply for the scheme.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Commerce and Industry:-**

 
 
• **MCI is a branch of the Government of India responsible for promoting trade and industry in the country. **
 
• The ministry is headed by a cabinet minister, who is currently Piyush Goyal.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare:-**
 
 
• **MoA&FW is a branch of the Government of India responsible for formulating and implementing policies and programs related to agriculture and farmers' welfare. **
 
• The ministry is headed by a cabinet minister, who is currently Narendra Singh Tomar.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises:-**
 
 
• **MSME is a branch of the Government of India responsible for formulating and implementing policies and programs related to micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). **
 
• The ministry is headed by a cabinet minister, who is currently Narayan Rane.
